1. Load Data 
```{r}
# Import libraries
set.seed(2)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

train_values <- read.csv("train_values.csv")
train_labels <- read.csv("train_labels.csv")

# Merge values and labels by building_id
buildings <- merge(train_values, train_labels, by = "building_id")

# Check dimensions
dim(buildings)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(buildings))

# Change categorical values to factors
categorical <- c(
  "geo_level_1_id",
  "land_surface_condition",
  "foundation_type",
  "roof_type",
  "ground_floor_type",
  "other_floor_type",
  "position",
  "plan_configuration",
  "legal_ownership_status",
  "damage_grade"
)

buildings[categorical] <- lapply(
  buildings[categorical],
  as.factor
)

summary(buildings)

# Distribution of response variable
ggplot(buildings, aes(x = damage_grade)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = "Damage Grade",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of Damage Grade"
  )
```

### START MODELS

4. Multinomial logistic regression 

First, we will fit and evaluate a simple multi-class logistic regression model. 

```{r}
library(rsample)
library(tidymodels)
library(parsnip)

buildings <- buildings %>%
  select(-building_id, -geo_level_2_id, -geo_level_3_id)

data_split <- initial_split(
  data = buildings,
  prop = 0.60,
  strata = damage_grade
)

train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)

cv_folds <- vfold_cv(
  train_data,
  v = 10,
  strata = damage_grade
)

lr_spec <- multinom_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("nnet") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

lr_fit <- lr_spec %>% 
  fit(damage_grade ~ ., data = train_data)

lr_results <- fit_resamples(
  lr_spec,
  damage_grade ~ .,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, bal_accuracy, f_meas),
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

collect_metrics(lr_results)

lr_predictions <- collect_predictions(lr_results)

lr_recall <- lr_predictions %>%
  group_by(damage_grade) %>%
  summarise(
    recall = mean(.pred_class == damage_grade),
    observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lr_recall
```

We can use oversampling because of our uneven class distribution. Oversampling will help ensure that we have equal representation from each damage grade. 


```{r}
library(themis) 

lr_over_recipe <- recipe(damage_grade ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  step_upsample(damage_grade, over_ratio = 1) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

lr_over_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(lr_over_recipe) %>%
  add_model(lr_spec)

lr_over_results <- fit_resamples(
  lr_over_workflow,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, bal_accuracy, f_meas),
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

collect_metrics(lr_over_results)

lr_over_predictions <- collect_predictions(lr_over_results)

lr_over_recall <- lr_over_predictions %>%
  group_by(damage_grade) %>%
  summarise(
    recall = mean(.pred_class == damage_grade),
    observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lr_over_recall
```


5. Random Forest 
```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(mode = "classification", trees = tune(), min_n = tune(), mtry = tune()) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") 

rf_grid <- grid_random(
  trees(range = c(100L, 500L)),
  mtry(range = c(2L, 15L)),
  min_n(range = c(2L, 20L)),
  size = 10
)

rf_grid
```


```{r random forest tuning}
set.seed(2)

rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
  rf_spec,
  damage_grade ~ .,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  grid = rf_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(f_meas, accuracy, bal_accuracy),
  control = control_grid(save_pred = FALSE, verbose = TRUE
  )
)
```

```{r}
show_best(rf_tuned, metric = "f_meas")
```

```{r}
autoplot(rf_tuned)
```

```{r}
rf_best <- select_best(rf_tuned,metric = "f_meas")
rf_best
```

```{r}
rf_final <- finalize_model(rf_spec,rf_best)
rf_final
```

```{r rf final fit}
set.seed(2)

rf_last_fit <- last_fit(
  rf_final,
  damage_grade ~ .,
  split = data_split,
  metrics = metric_set(f_meas,accuracy,bal_accuracy)
)

collect_metrics(rf_last_fit)
```

```{r}
rf_predictions <- collect_predictions(rf_last_fit)

rf_recall <- rf_predictions |>
  group_by(damage_grade) |>
  summarise(
    recall = mean(.pred_class == damage_grade),
    observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
rf_recall

rf_confusion <- conf_mat(
  rf_predictions,
  truth = damage_grade,
  estimate = .pred_class
)
rf_confusion

autoplot(rf_confusion, type = "heatmap") +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Confusion Matrix",
    x = "Actual Damage Grade",
    y = "Predicted Damage Grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r rf importance}
rf_fitted <- extract_fit_engine(rf_last_fit)

rf_importance <- tibble(
  predictor = names(rf_fitted$variable.importance),
  importance = as.numeric(rf_fitted$variable.importance)
) |>
  arrange(desc(importance))

rf_importance |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rf_importance |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  mutate(predictor = forcats::fct_reorder(predictor, importance)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = importance, y = predictor)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Random Forest Predictors",
    x = "Impurity-Based Importance",
    y = "Building Characteristic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
### Class-weighted Random Forest

```{r Class Weighted Random Forest}
class_counts <- table(train_data$damage_grade)

class_weights <- as.numeric(
  sum(class_counts) /
  (length(class_counts) * class_counts)
)

names(class_weights) <- names(class_counts)
class_weights
```

```{r}
rf_weighted_spec <- rand_forest(mode = "classification", trees = 440, min_n = 10, mtry = 12) |>
  set_engine("ranger", class.weights = !!class_weights, importance = "none")

set.seed(2)

rf_weighted_cv <- fit_resamples(
  rf_weighted_spec,
  damage_grade ~ .,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(f_meas, accuracy,bal_accuracy),
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
collect_metrics(rf_weighted_cv)
```


```{r}
rf_weighted_predictions <- collect_predictions(rf_weighted_cv)

rf_weighted_predictions |>
  group_by(damage_grade) |>
  summarise(
    recall = mean(.pred_class == damage_grade),
    observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

6. SVM

6. SVM

```{r svm setup}
library(kernlab)

set.seed(2)

# Stratified subsample for tuning
svm_train <- train_data %>%
  group_by(damage_grade) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.065) %>%
  ungroup()

table(svm_train$damage_grade)

svm_folds <- vfold_cv(
  svm_train,
  v = 5,
  strata = damage_grade
)

# SVMs need numeric, scaled predictors
svm_recipe <- recipe(damage_grade ~ ., data = svm_train) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%   # drops dummy columns for rare levels that are all 0 in a fold
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# Class weights: inverse class frequency
svm_counts <- table(svm_train$damage_grade)

svm_weights <- as.numeric(
  sum(svm_counts) /
  (length(svm_counts) * svm_counts)
)

names(svm_weights) <- names(svm_counts)
svm_weights

# prob.model = FALSE skips kernlab's internal probability CV
svm_spec <- svm_rbf(cost = tune(), rbf_sigma = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("kernlab", class.weights = !!svm_weights, prob.model = FALSE) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

svm_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(svm_recipe) %>%
  add_model(svm_spec)

# Quadratic weighted kappa for the ordinal target
kap_quad <- metric_tweak("kap_quad", kap, weighting = "quadratic")

svm_metrics <- metric_set(f_meas, accuracy, bal_accuracy, kap_quad)

# cost is on a log2 scale, rbf_sigma on a log10 scale 
svm_grid <- grid_regular(
  cost(range = c(-2, 5)),
  rbf_sigma(range = c(-3, -1)),
  levels = c(4, 3)
)

svm_grid
```

```{r svm tuning}
set.seed(2)

svm_tuned <- tune_grid(
  svm_workflow,
  resamples = svm_folds,
  grid = svm_grid,
  metrics = svm_metrics,
  control = control_grid(save_pred = FALSE, verbose = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
show_best(svm_tuned, metric = "f_meas")
```

```{r}
autoplot(svm_tuned)
```

```{r}
svm_best <- select_best(svm_tuned, metric = "f_meas")
svm_best

svm_final_workflow <- finalize_workflow(svm_workflow, svm_best)
svm_final_workflow
```

```{r svm final fit}
set.seed(2)

# Larger stratified subsample for the final fit
svm_train_final <- train_data %>%
  group_by(damage_grade) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.20) %>%
  ungroup()

svm_final_fit <- fit(svm_final_workflow, data = svm_train_final)

# Test set performance
svm_predictions <- predict(svm_final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data %>% select(damage_grade))

svm_metrics(svm_predictions, truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
```

```{r}
svm_recall <- svm_predictions %>%
  group_by(damage_grade) %>%
  summarise(
    recall = mean(.pred_class == damage_grade),
    observations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
svm_recall

svm_confusion <- conf_mat(
  svm_predictions,
  truth = damage_grade,
  estimate = .pred_class
)
svm_confusion

autoplot(svm_confusion, type = "heatmap") +
  labs(
    title = "SVM Confusion Matrix",
    x = "Actual Damage Grade",
    y = "Predicted Damage Grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

8. LDA
```{r}
library(discrim)

lda_spec <- discrim_linear() %>%
  set_engine("MASS") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

lda_fit <- lda_spec %>%
  fit(damage_grade ~ ., data = train_data)

lda_results <- fit_resamples(
  lda_spec,
  damage_grade ~ .,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, f_meas)
)

collect_metrics(lda_results)

#Test Data Performance
lda_predictions <- predict(lda_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data %>% select(damage_grade))

accuracy(lda_predictions, truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
f_meas(lda_predictions, truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
conf_mat(lda_predictions, truth = damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)
```
